# New AI Tools - October 2026

## October 2026

8 added

![Alsona](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Falsona.png&w=64&q=80)

[Alsona](/ai-tools/alsona)

Alsona helps founders, sales teams, and agencies find prospects showing buying intent. Its AI agents monitor 32 standard signals, score accounts against your ideal customer profile, and personalize LinkedIn and email outreach. A unified inbox and CRM integrations keep prospect data and conversations in one workflow. Signal coverage and automation capabilities vary by plan.

[AI Sales & Revenue](/categories/ai-sales)Added Oct 16, 2026

![Glean](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.prod.website-files.com%2F6127a84dfe068e153ef20572%2F67189bf127c626679a308b22_32x32%2520Glean%2520Favicon.png&w=64&q=80)

[Glean](/ai-tools/glean)

Glean connects company information to support permission-aware enterprise search, AI assistance, and agents. Teams can find answers across connected business systems and build workflows using company context.

[Enterprise AI Search & Context](/categories/enterprise-ai-search)Added Oct 10, 2026

![AiGirlfriends.ai](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Faigirlfriends.ai%2Flove.svg%3F__frsh_c%3D4806aff88a4a8a6ecfebe555a820986185a844a3&w=64&q=80)

[AiGirlfriends.ai](/ai-tools/aigirlfriends-ai)

AiGirlfriends.ai lets adults create or choose virtual AI companions, chat with them, and generate images and videos. The platform also offers voice messages and calls.

[AI Chatbots & Companions](/categories/ai-chatbots)Added Oct 10, 2026

![AI Agent Testing by TestMu AI](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fai-agent-testing-by-testmu-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[AI Agent Testing by TestMu AI](/ai-tools/ai-agent-testing-by-testmu-ai)

TestMu AI Agent Testing is an AI agent testing platform that uses 15+ AI evaluators to test chatbots, voice assistants, and phone agents before launch. It generates 60-100+ scenarios from PRDs, docs, Jira, or Confluence, scores conversations for hallucination, bias, and compliance, and returns a Green, Yellow, or Red go-live verdict. A pay-as-you-go tier starts at $0 with credits at $0.01 each.

[AI Support Agents](/categories/ai-support-agents)Added Oct 3, 2026

![KaneAI by TestMu AI](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fkane-ai-by-testmu-ai-2026-10.png&w=64&q=80)

[KaneAI by TestMu AI](/ai-tools/kane-ai-by-testmu-ai)

KaneAI is a GenAI-native AI testing agent from TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) that lets teams plan, author, run, and maintain end-to-end tests in plain English across web, mobile, and APIs. It turns Jira tickets, PRDs, and screenshots into test cases, self-heals when the UI changes, and exports to Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium. Plans start at $19 per agent per month with a 14-day free trial.

[AI Code Agents](/categories/ai-code-assistants)Added Oct 2, 2026

![Kane CLI by TestMu AI](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fkane-cli-by-testmu-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[Kane CLI by TestMu AI](/ai-tools/kane-cli-by-testmu-ai)

Kane CLI is a free AI testing agent and browser testing CLI from TestMu AI that runs plain-English test objectives in real Chrome. It returns structured pass or fail results with a sealed evidence pack, works as a verification step for AI coding agents like Claude Code, and gates CI/CD pipelines through standard exit codes. Local and CI runs are free; cloud runs draw on KaneAI plan credits.

[AI Code Agents](/categories/ai-code-assistants)Added Oct 2, 2026

![Stape](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fstape.png&w=64&q=80)

[Stape](/ai-tools/stape)

Stape is a server-side tagging platform that hosts server Google Tag Manager containers and runs conversion API gateways for Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat, helping marketers recover conversions lost to ad blockers and browser tracking limits.

[Marketing & SEO](/categories/ai-marketing)Added Oct 2, 2026

![Preserve Chat: Share a WhatsApp Chats as a Readable Link](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpreserve.chat%2Ficon.svg&w=64&q=80)

[Preserve Chat: Share a WhatsApp Chats as a Readable Link](/ai-tools/preserve-chat-share-a-whatsapp-chats-as-a-readable-link)

Preserve Chat turns WhatsApp chats into clean, readable conversation pages links that you can share.

[Business & Productivity](/categories/ai-business)Added Oct 1, 2026

## September 2026

42 added

![Zaro](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fzaro.ai%2Ffavicon.svg%3Fv%3Dmufhpugq&w=64&q=80)

[Zaro](/ai-tools/zaro)

Zaro provides governed business context that people and authorised AI agents can read, inspect, correct, and write back to. It preserves findings and decisions for later workflows. Enterprise teams should evaluate it when they need reusable context beyond employee document discovery. Pricing combines an annual platform fee with consumption and is quoted per deployment.

[Enterprise AI Search & Context](/categories/enterprise-ai-search)Added Sep 29, 2026

![Onepage](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fonepage.png&w=64&q=80)

[Onepage](/ai-tools/onepage)

Onepage is a no-code AI website builder from Frankfurt that turns a prompt into a live landing page, small business site, or multi-step funnel. It bundles hosting, SSL, a built-in CRM, AI SEO tooling, and an MCP connector for Claude and Cursor, with a free plan and paid plans from $19.90/month.

[AI Website Builders](/categories/ai-website-builders)Added Sep 28, 2026

![Ultimarii](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fultimarii.png&w=64&q=80)

[Ultimarii](/ai-tools/ultimarii)

Ultimarii is a Calgary-based regulatory AI company that helps energy, utilities and legal professionals navigate and streamline application and permitting processes. It raised a Series A of more than $13 million CAD in September 2026, backed by BDC and Mistral Venture Partners.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Augmeta](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Faugmeta.png&w=64&q=80)

[Augmeta](/ai-tools/augmeta)

Augmeta assigns an AI agent, called an operator, to monitor, investigate and act on each of a company's key business metrics. The Redmond startup calls this Agentic KPI Ops and raised $3 million in seed funding in September 2026, led by Depth Ventures.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Embedd](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fembedd.png&w=64&q=80)

[Embedd](/ai-tools/embedd)

Embedd automates the code semiconductors need to communicate with system software by building a digital twin of the hardware and using AI agents to generate the code. The London startup raised $2.7 million in pre-seed funding in August 2026, led by Seedcamp.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Echovane](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fechovane.png&w=64&q=80)

[Echovane](/ai-tools/echovane)

Echovane is an AI-native market research platform whose agents design studies, recruit and verify participants, run multimodal fieldwork and synthesize results into interactive dashboards. It closed a $1 million pre-seed round in August 2026, co-led by Titan Capital and Neon Fund.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Ekai](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fekai.png&w=64&q=80)

[Ekai](/ai-tools/ekai)

Ekai is an enterprise data platform that writes semantic models and data transformation code for AI tools, starting from definitions set by domain experts. Every generated artifact is validated against warehouse data before it ships. The company raised $1.7 million in pre-seed funding in September 2026, led by Misneach.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Eve Security](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Feve-security.png&w=64&q=80)

[Eve Security](/ai-tools/eve-security)

Eve Security provides a runtime security layer that gives organizations observability, governance and real-time controls over AI agents, letting teams intervene when an agent misbehaves. It raised $4.5 million in September 2026, led by Run Ventures, extending its total seed round to $7.5 million.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Arrakis](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Farrakis.png&w=64&q=80)

[Arrakis](/ai-tools/arrakis)

Arrakis is a London- and Paris-based startup building an AI operating system for industrial companies in aerospace, energy, logistics and manufacturing. It emerged from stealth in July 2026 with $38 million, including a $30 million Series A led by Blossom Capital at a $140 million post-money valuation.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Vikk AI](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fvikk-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[Vikk AI](/ai-tools/vikk-ai)

Vikk AI is a consumer legal AI platform where people type legal questions and get plain-language answers, document reviews and simple drafts. It also sells law firms sponsored placements matched to user needs, and raised $4.2 million across pre-seed and seed rounds, announced in July 2026.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Wild Zebra](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fwild-zebra.png&w=64&q=80)

[Wild Zebra](/ai-tools/wild-zebra)

Wild Zebra is an AI learning platform for students in grades 2 through 9 that teaches math and reading with a Socratic, question-led approach grounded in each student's hobbies. The Seattle company raised a $6 million seed round in August 2026, led by Trilogy Equity Partners.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Lightsage](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Flightsage.png&w=64&q=80)

[Lightsage](/ai-tools/lightsage)

Lightsage helps software companies see how AI coding agents and answer engines discover, choose and use their products, then diagnoses why agents fail. It raised a $4 million seed round in September 2026, led by Nexus Venture Partners.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Thri5](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fthri5.png&w=64&q=80)

[Thri5](/ai-tools/thri5)

Thri5 is building an AI execution layer for retailers that uses agentic AI to understand how work gets done, find where value is lost and help teams act. Founded by former Loblaw Digital leaders, it raised $5.4 million USD in seed funding in September 2026.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Aron](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Faron.png&w=64&q=80)

[Aron](/ai-tools/aron)

Aron is an AI procurement platform whose agents collect supplier bids over email, send follow-ups, review contracts against internal policy and flag invoices that diverge from contract prices. The company launched in September 2026 with $8 million in funding, including a $6 million seed led by Storm Ventures.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![logcat.ai](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Flogcat-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[logcat.ai](/ai-tools/logcat-ai)

logcat.ai builds AI agents that analyze device logs to find the root cause of bugs across the kernel, modem and firmware of Android and Linux devices. The Seattle startup raised $2.55 million in pre-seed funding in July 2026, led by Founders' Co-op.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Atira](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fatira.png&w=64&q=80)

[Atira](/ai-tools/atira)

Atira is a Munich-based startup whose AI agents automate industrial sales engineering, turning incoming customer requests into technical documentation, configurations and priced bids. It raised $17.5 million in September 2026, a $15 million seed led by Accel plus a previously undisclosed $2.5 million pre-seed.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![TacnIQ.ai](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Ftacniq-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[TacnIQ.ai](/ai-tools/tacniq-ai)

TacnIQ.ai is a Singapore and California-based physical AI startup developing technology that lets machines and robots interpret tactile sensations. It has built a tactile dataset of more than 5,000 hours of interactions and makes sensor nodes to capture physical signals. In September 2026 it raised $1.5 million from lead investor In Group Holdings as part of a $3 million pre-seed round.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![nocall.ai](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fnocall-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[nocall.ai](/ai-tools/nocall-ai)

nocall.ai is a Tokyo-based generative AI phone service that automates business phone calls such as appointment confirmations and payment reminders. It is used in automotive, finance, recruiting and IT. In September 2026 it raised about 800 million yen in a Series A co-led by JAFCO and Archetype Ventures, bringing total funding above 1 billion yen.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Superleap](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fsuperleap.png&w=64&q=80)

[Superleap](/ai-tools/superleap)

Superleap is a Bengaluru-based AI-native CRM for enterprise revenue teams. It combines a unified data layer, agentic automation, AI voice bots and conversational intelligence, plus a tool for migrating off legacy CRMs. In August 2026 it raised Rs 36 crore (about $4.2 million) in a pre-Series A round led by Peak XV Partners' Surge.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Heidi](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fheidi-health.png&w=64&q=80)

[Heidi](/ai-tools/heidi-health)

Heidi is an Australian AI healthcare platform that records appointments and produces structured documents for medical professionals. In September 2026 it secured $475 million, made up of a $140 million Series C led by Blackbird and $335 million in non-equity growth funding from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund. The raise valued the company at $1.26 billion.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Sophiie AI](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fsophiie-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[Sophiie AI](/ai-tools/sophiie-ai)

Sophiie AI is a Gold Coast-based AI virtual receptionist and administrative assistant for tradies and service businesses. It answers calls and handles admin so small operators do not miss work while on the job. In August 2026 it raised a $5 million seed round with investors including Archangel Ventures, Admiralty Capital Group and Antler.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Runable](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Frunable.png&w=64&q=80)

[Runable](/ai-tools/runable)

Runable is a Bengaluru-based AI agent that helps small businesses build digital products such as websites, apps and presentations and then grow them through ads, social media, SEO and chatbot optimization. It reported 1.7 million registered users. In August 2026 it raised a $21 million Series A co-led by Susquehanna Venture Capital and Nexus Venture Partners.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Scape](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fscape-email.png&w=64&q=80)

[Scape](/ai-tools/scape-email)

Scape is a Stockholm-based AI-native email client that prepares work before you open a thread, drafting replies, generating or editing attachments and surfacing only the emails that need attention. It learns from the inbox and a built-in local meeting notetaker. In July 2026 it emerged from stealth with $3.2 million from Y Combinator, General Catalyst and FundersClub.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Nuvia](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fnuvia-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[Nuvia](/ai-tools/nuvia-ai)

Nuvia is a Brazilian startup that builds AI agents for sales and customer service. Its platform connects WhatsApp, Instagram, voice, web and email with CRMs and business tools to automate customer interactions. In September 2026 it raised $1.8 million in a round led by Amador Capital and Nascent.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Roma AI](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Froma-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[Roma AI](/ai-tools/roma-ai)

Roma AI is a Uruguayan Chilean platform that lets companies build and manage AI agents connected to internal systems such as payment platforms, calendars, catalogs and proprietary software. It keeps sensitive data within each client's infrastructure and lets companies monitor and audit agent actions. In August 2026 it raised a $1.2 million seed round led by Invexor Venture Partners.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Magnar](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fmagnar.png&w=64&q=80)

[Magnar](/ai-tools/magnar)

Magnar is a Chilean legal AI platform that helps lawyers research legislation and case law, analyze information and draft and review documents. It integrates with Microsoft Word and Outlook and uses legal sources specific to each market. In September 2026 it raised an $8 million Series A led by 6 Degrees Capital and Hi Ventures.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Arrakis Security](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Farrakis-security.png&w=64&q=80)

[Arrakis Security](/ai-tools/arrakis-security)

Arrakis Security is an Israeli platform that discovers, monitors and governs the behavior of enterprise AI agents. It builds behavioral profiles, detects suspicious activity and can block unauthorized actions or revoke permissions automatically. In August 2026 it raised an $8 million Seed round led by Hetz Ventures.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Itoflow](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fitoflow.png&w=64&q=80)

[Itoflow](/ai-tools/itoflow)

Itoflow is a UK AI platform that helps professional investment teams scale research and portfolio management. Its agents learn how each firm researches opportunities, manages risk and reviews portfolios, then run those processes continuously across asset classes. In August 2026 it raised $2.5 million (1.8 million pounds) in pre-seed funding led by Balderton Capital.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Gaia](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fgaia-sa.png&w=64&q=80)

[Gaia](/ai-tools/gaia-sa)

Gaia is a Saudi Arabia-based sovereign AI platform for enterprises that connects knowledge, files, emails, systems and workflows while keeping data inside the organization. It combines enterprise search, a generative AI assistant and AI agents with human approval for high-risk steps. In September 2026 it raised $1.5 million in a pre-Seed round led by Seedra Ventures.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![DataAgent](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fdataagent.png&w=64&q=80)

[DataAgent](/ai-tools/dataagent)

DataAgent is a Tel Aviv-based AI platform for Kubernetes and connected infrastructure that identifies faults and applies verified fixes on its own. It runs inside the customer's cluster so telemetry never leaves their environment. In September 2026 it emerged from stealth with a $10 million pre-Seed round led by MizMaa Ventures and Alicorn Venture Partners.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Catch](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fcatch-ai.png&w=64&q=80)

[Catch](/ai-tools/catch-ai)

Catch is a Tel Aviv-based AI assistant that takes over day-to-day administration for executives, including meeting scheduling, task delegation and email handling. It works over text, email, Slack or phone and requires explicit approval before any financial transaction. In September 2026 it emerged from stealth with a $5 million Seed round co-led by Entree Capital and Pitango.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Xpander](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fxpander.png&w=64&q=80)

[Xpander](/ai-tools/xpander)

Xpander is an infrastructure platform that lets companies build, deploy and manage AI agents across different models, cloud providers and frameworks. It offers a universal agent harness and Omni, an agentic forward deployed engineer. In August 2026 it raised a $7.5 million Seed round led by Pico Venture Partners.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Infini](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Finfini-money.png&w=64&q=80)

[Infini](/ai-tools/infini-money)

Infini is a Hong Kong-based AI financial platform that combines instant stablecoin settlement with AI agents for money management and treasury. It offers business payments, corporate cards, invoicing and stablecoin treasury, plus automated digital CFO features. Infini raised a $6M seed round in September 2026.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Crux Analytics](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fcrux-analytics.png&w=64&q=80)

[Crux Analytics](/ai-tools/crux-analytics)

Crux Analytics is a fintech platform that helps community banks and credit unions identify, acquire and manage high-potential small business clients. It uses agentic business development workflows to automate bankers' operational tasks. Crux raised a $2.2M seed round led by Castle Creek Launchpad in September 2026, bringing total funding to $3.2M.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![AVACAREER](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Favacareer.png&w=64&q=80)

[AVACAREER](/ai-tools/avacareer)

AVACAREER is a mid-career recruitment platform from Tokyo-based NexusAdvisors in which AI agents conduct initial interviews between job seekers and employers. AI avatars assess fit and generate skill and culture match scores before human involvement. NexusAdvisors raised a 50 million yen seed round led by ANOBAKA and East Ventures in August 2026.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Boxd](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fboxd.png&w=64&q=80)

[Boxd](/ai-tools/boxd)

Boxd provides persistent, hardware-isolated Linux virtual machines in the cloud for developers and AI coding agents. Teams compose one VM and then spin up as many copies as they need to run code and tests in parallel. The Dutch startup raised a $2M pre-seed round led by BlueYard Capital in September 2026.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Flatkey](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fflatkey.png&w=64&q=80)

[Flatkey](/ai-tools/flatkey)

Flatkey is an AI infrastructure platform that gives developers one API key and one balance for 100+ official AI models and 1,000+ AI tools. Calls route to providers' official endpoints, with most models priced around 80 percent of official list prices. The San Jose company announced a $10M Series A in September 2026 after passing 10,000 developers in two months.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Sapiom](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fsapiom.png&w=64&q=80)

[Sapiom](/ai-tools/sapiom)

Sapiom is an infrastructure platform that helps teams move AI agents from prototype to production by addressing cost, latency and reliability. Its product suite includes Sapiom Router, Sapiom Agent Studio and Sapiom Runtime. The San Francisco company raised a $35M Series A led by Dragonfly in August 2026, bringing total funding to $50M.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Blee](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fblee.png&w=64&q=80)

Blee is an AI-first marketing compliance platform that helps legal, compliance and brand teams review and govern marketing, product and sales content. It flags regulatory, legal and brand issues before review and monitors published content afterward. The New York company raised a $20M Series A co-led by Fin Capital and SMBC Fin Atlas Beyond Fund in September 2026, bringing total funding to $27M.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![Conveo](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Fconveo.png&w=64&q=80)

Conveo is an AI consumer research platform that runs AI-moderated qualitative video interviews and analyzes them with multimodal AI. Brands use it to inform marketing, product and strategy decisions. Conveo raised a $50M Series A in September 2026 with DST Global Partners, Balderton Capital and others, bringing total funding to $55.8M.

Added Sep 25, 2026

![UrgentIQ](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fd24zn84hb3s9t2.cloudfront.net%2Flogos%2Furgentiq.png&w=64&q=80)

UrgentIQ is an AI-native electronic medical record and operating platform built for urgent care centers. It combines scheduling, intake, clinical documentation, AI-powered coding, revenue cycle management and payments. The New York company raised a $15M Series A from Five Elms Capital in September 2026.

Added Sep 25, 2026

Discernis is a New York City legal intelligence company whose AI platform analyzes full document collections for litigation and investigations. It deploys on-premises or in secure client cloud environments instead of calling third-party AI APIs. Discernis announced a $2.5M seed round led by Newfund Capital in August 2026.
